# The Forward Pass

> The Forward Pass is a daily intelligence newsletter for people who build with AI. It covers AI engineering, with a news archive and editorial articles.

The canonical website is https://theforwardpass.net. The free plan provides a general daily issue. Personal provides an issue based on the reader's interests. Professional adds weekly research on the reader's brief. Read the pricing page for current prices, trial terms, and archive access.

Start with the public archive for published coverage. Follow its article links and use the article's URL and publication date when citing it. Follow linked original sources when checking research or product claims. News describes events at publication time and may have changed since then.

Archive content can depend on the reader's session and subscription. A sign-in, upgrade, or unavailable notice is not the article's content. Personal editions and account preferences are not public reference material. The links below lead to HTML pages unless a file format is specified.

## Read

- [Home](https://theforwardpass.net/): Newsletter overview and coverage.
- [News archive](https://theforwardpass.net/archive): Discover published stories and follow their source links.
- [Editorial archive](https://theforwardpass.net/archive?section=editorial): Browse editorial articles and follow individual article links.
- [Pricing](https://theforwardpass.net/pricing): Current plans, features, prices, trial terms, and archive access.

## Optional

- [Collaborate](https://theforwardpass.net/collaborate): Advertising and sponsorship information.
- [Privacy](https://theforwardpass.net/privacy): How subscriber data is handled.
- [Imprint](https://theforwardpass.net/imprint): Publisher information.
- [Sitemap](https://theforwardpass.net/sitemap.xml): XML index of public landing pages. Discover articles through the archive.
- [Crawler rules](https://theforwardpass.net/robots.txt): Crawl permissions for automated clients.
